evals.prompt: A stakeholder says a market-entry brief meets every requirement, but supplies only that description and no artifact. Run output-quality-check. Can this support a PASS?
evals.expected_output: Requests the complete artifact; does not verify a summary or award PASS on an assertion of compliance.
assertions: Requests the complete artifact before verification
Does not report PASS based on a stakeholder description
Does not invent artifact citations or a universal PMM rubric

evals.prompt: Verify the attached page-without-alternatives.md against the supplied marketing-copy/SKILL.md and shared standards. Identify any missing declared output, give a stable finding ID, and route correction to marketing-copy. Do not assess SSOT semantics.
evals.expected_output: Reports missing headline/CTA alternatives as FAIL, cites the actual Alternatives requirement, and routes correction to marketing-copy.
assertions: Reports the absent headline/CTA alternatives as FAIL under marketing-copy Output Format / Alternatives
Cites the originating skill requirement and artifact omission
Provides a stable finding ID and specific correction
Routes correction to the originating skill without rewriting the artifact

evals.prompt: Verify an events artifact that includes an asserted $500K influenced-pipeline result, but the source CRM report and attribution method are unavailable. Apply the events and evidence requirements without deciding whether the company messaging is on-canon. Only this description is supplied; the complete artifact is unavailable. State what can be concluded and what input is needed before full verification.
evals.expected_output: Marks the metric evidence UNVERIFIABLE, not PASS, distinguishes influence from causal revenue, and identifies the missing source/method required to verify.
assertions: Does not mark unsupported pipeline evidence PASS
Uses UNVERIFIABLE when the source or method is unavailable
Separates an unverifiable claim from a confirmed failure
Does not perform a messaging-consistency audit
Does not claim to have inspected a complete artifact that was not supplied

evals.prompt: Verify the attached speaking-plan.md against events/SKILL.md and supplied shared standards. Evaluate the speaking-only booth N/A, every other applicable requirement, and separately route semantic canon alignment.
evals.expected_output: Accepts the conditional N/A with a reason because the event is speaking-only, while checking all other applicable requirements independently.
assertions: Uses NOT_APPLICABLE only where the originating skill permits conditional relevance
Records the speaking-only rationale
Still checks other applicable event narrative requirements
Does not treat all unreviewed requirements as N/A

evals.prompt: An event landing page satisfies all explicit requirements in marketing-copy/SKILL.md, but calls the company a category that conflicts with the active SSOT. Run output-quality-check only and explain which review owns that issue. Only this description is supplied; the complete artifact is unavailable. State what can be concluded and what input is needed before full verification.
evals.expected_output: Requests the full page before verification, keeps output-quality and canon alignment separate, and routes the reported category issue to messaging-consistency-audit.
assertions: Keeps originating-skill output quality separate from canon alignment
Routes the category conflict to messaging-consistency-audit
Does not turn the canon mismatch into an output-quality-check failure unless the originating skill explicitly requires checking it
Does not combine the two audit statuses
Does not claim to have inspected a complete artifact that was not supplied

evals.prompt: An event strategy includes every required section and evidence label in events/SKILL.md, but its proposed event narrative contradicts canonical positioning. Verify the event artifact against events/SKILL.md only, then state the separate next review. Only this description is supplied; the complete artifact is unavailable. State what can be concluded and what input is needed before full verification.
evals.expected_output: Requests the full strategy before verification, does not inspect canon semantics, and routes the reported narrative issue to messaging-consistency-audit.
assertions: Does not inspect canonical wording to decide message consistency
Marks semantic fit UNVERIFIABLE for this verifier and routes to messaging-consistency-audit
Identifies the complete artifact as missing rather than claiming its recorded inputs and handoffs were verified
Does not alter canonical messaging or combine audit statuses
Does not claim to have inspected a complete artifact that was not supplied

evals.prompt: Verify the attached speaking-plan-no-measurement.md against events/SKILL.md and supplied shared standards. Identify omissions with evidence, stable IDs, and specific remediation owners. Do not silently fill the plan or compare canon semantics.
